description: Western Province - Annaincing that 03 By-Laws drafted by the Negombo Municipal Council were adapted by the western Province Provincial Cauncil
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the adoption of municipal by-laws (relating to private fairs, water pipes, underground cables, and construction pillars/towers) by the Western Province Provincial Council. The content focuses on regulatory frameworks and legal instruments (by-laws) under specific ordinances and acts. While it mentions the Chief Minister's approval, this is in the context of the legal adoption process rather than being primarily about government personnel or structure. The core subject matter is the establishment of regulatory controls and charges, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
